MIXED GRASS FIELD · THREE EXISTING VARIANTS
Floor material stays subordinate to interactions and silhouettes.

FAR GAMEPLAY + REPEAT STRESS · 18 PX / CELL
No character multiplier applied to floor or ground art.
Institutional substrates remain legible; use appears as restrained wear; grass relies on sparse living detail and three existing variants instead of large repeated patches.
• Material noun reads before ornament or wear.
• Replaceable modules use quiet seams; poured and sheet materials use fewer seams.
• QuotaCo accent color is reserved for thresholds and service cues.
• No tile outline, contact shadow, bevel, or character-scale multiplier.
• Large repeating ovals from the direction proof are removed.
• Lawn, deep, and soft-field variants differ by density and palette—not scale.
• Tufts and flowers remain sparse enough to survive prop and employee occlusion.
• Mixed use of the three existing IDs supplies low-frequency field variation.
template IDs · instance IDs · params · palettes
Approve, revise selected materials, or reject. Approval authorizes genuine artist-editable SVG source creation and importer design—not export or Unity promotion.
The derived 47-frame grass-fringe remains code-owned. After the base grass source is accepted, it must inherit these palettes and edge-density rules in a separate proof.
no standalone floor/ground SVG files · no template/default mutation · no snapshot promotion · no exporter/contract/schema change · no bundle export/import · no Unity change · no commit
1. Do all 12 floor materials read as different physical surfaces?
2. Do seams clarify construction without turning the room into a grid overlay?
3. Does the grass feel living and soft without becoming noisy behind props?
4. Does the three-variant field hide repetition at normal and far zoom?
